description_en: Initiate a network diagnosis for a single Internet of Things SIM card
description_zh: 发起单张物联网卡的网络诊断
kebab_example: aliyun cc5g submit-diagnose-task-for-single-card --wireless-cloud-connector-id cc5g-xxxx --source 89860477102170127555 --begin-time 1662307201200 --end-time 1662307201200 --region-no cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitDiagnoseTaskForSingleCard

parameters.help_en: The ID of the 5G high-speed cloud instance
parameters.name: wireless_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source Internet of Things SIM card for the network diagnosis
parameters.help_zh: 网络诊断的源物联网卡ID
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The destination IP address or domain name for the network diagnosis
parameters.help_zh: 网络诊断的目的IP或者域名
parameters.name: destination

parameters.help_en: The UNIX timestamp indicating the start time of the network diagnosis. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 网络诊断的开始时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The UNIX timestamp indicating the end time of the network diagnosis. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 网络诊断的结束时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the 5G high-speed cloud instance
parameters.name: region_no

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the user of the cloud connector instance
parameters.help_zh: 云连接器实例使用者的阿里云账号ID
parameters.name: resource_uid
